evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Medial meniscus: Large, complex tear of the body and posterior horn.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: Small tear at posterior root.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: Severe, diffuse cartilage loss.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: Mild cartilage thinning and fissuring at the weightbearing aspect.
evidence.PF OA: Patella cartilage: Moderate to severe cartilage loss, lateral greater than medial.
evidence.Contusion: Subchondral insufficiency fracture central weightbearing aspect of the medial femoral condyle as well as the adjacent tibia with moderate bone marrow edema.
evidence.Fracture: Subchondral insufficiency fractures at the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau.
